title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What’s the deal with this Colon report...someone from Dominican tweeted he’s closing in on a minors deal
And a person who would know said “no”
Hey man, if you have a rules question or something technical I can help with that. Otherwise I’m not the right person
So that’s the kind of help you meant when you called me hyperventilating, “about to throw up,” saying you would help me out in the future, begging me not to write the Fulmer trade
Anthony, we should discuss the situation face to face.

Yeah for sure. I don’t like sounding like that - I like you and I appreciate the way our relationship has developed - but it makes me feel like I got sold a bill of goods and that really pisses me off. I try to avoid you at the park because I know you’re paranoid and when I call, it’s just to test you. This is all part of the process, though. Thanks for getting back to me
